items.title: Potential Donors for Kidney Transplant (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Potential Donors for Kidney Transplant: a main subheading of 14.3.4 Kidney Transplant, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 22-23.

blocks.text: Related donor (rishtedar donor): jo shakhs recipient ka khooni (genetic) rishtedar ho, jaise maan baap, bhai behan ya aulad, woh gurde ka sab se behtar donor ho sakta hai.

Unrelated donor (ghair rishtedar donor): yeh donor recipient ka khooni rishtedar nahin hota, jaise shauhar ya biwi, dost ya saath kaam karne wala. Is qisam ka atiya kam aam hai, lekin agar donor aur recipient ka blood group aur tissue type mil jaye to yeh bhi kamyab ho sakta hai.

Deceased donor (faut shuda donor): bohat se log hospitals mein register karwate hain ke maut ke baad un ke organs atiya kar diye jayen. Un ke organs, gurdon samet, un logon ko diye ja sakte hain jinhen transplant ki zaroorat ho. Faut shuda donor ke gurde recipient se blood group, tissue type aur immune system ki mutabiqat (compatibility) ki buniyad par ehtiyat se milaye jate hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text:
Gurde ka atiya aakhri darje ki gurde ki bimari wale shakhs ke liye zindagi bachane wala tohfa ho sakta hai.
Kitab ke mutabiq gurda dene se donor ki sehat ko lambe arse ka koi khaas khatra nahin, aur tehqeeq (studies) se pata chala hai ke aam taur par donors ki sehat ya umar par koi bura asar nahin parta.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
Kitab ke mutabiq Pakistan ka pehla kidney transplant centre 1985 mein Karachi ke Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) mein qaim hua. Yeh duniya ke sab se bare aur kamyab transplant centres mein se ek hai.
Pakistan Kidney and Liver Institute & Research Center (PKLI&RC) 2017 mein qaim hua. Yeh Lahore mein ek tertiary-care (sab se aala darje ka) hospital hai, jo gurde aur jigar ki bimariyon ke bare qaumi masle se nimatne ke liye bana, aur ilaj, transplant aur tehqeeq ka khaas markaz hai.
